claim: Registered deep-credit claim (R9.3 flagship): Under depth-scaled credit assignment on a stationary synthetic stream, the memory profile cleanly separates exact-global credit (gradient/FA) requiring O(depth) saved-activation bytes from local credit (thermodynamic_contrast) requiring O(1) bytes. At the registered deep tier (depth=50), gradient's saved-activation memory reaches ~450 KiB while thermodynamic_contrast stays at 0 KiB — a deterministic architecture-level separation. On probe accuracy, gradient retains above-chance performance at depth=50 (pilot mean 0.24, sd 0.044) while thermodynamic_contrast collapses toward chance (pilot mean 0.11, sd 0.072), yielding a large gradient-vs-thermo contrast (pilot Cohen's d ≈ 2.1). The registered commission fixes n=16/group at the pilot variance to confirm the memory-profile separation and the probe-accuracy contrast at the deep tier. Controls: planted lr=0 frozen arm at chance in all depth environments (R8.5).
